checks.entity_identity: Narrative: “Storm surge is measured above the predicted tide”; evidence: “Storm surge is the abnormal rise in seawater level during a storm, measured as the height of the water above the normal predicted astronomical tide.” The terms and referents are consistent.

checks.actor_object: Narrative: “storm winds pushing water onshore”; evidence: “The surge is caused primarily by a storm’s winds pushing water onshore.” Agent, action, and object are consistent.
checks.causal_relationship: Narrative: “caused primarily by storm winds pushing water onshore”; evidence: “The surge is caused primarily by a storm’s winds pushing water onshore.” Causal direction and strength are preserved.
checks.quantitative_meaning: Narrative: “surge is the storm-driven increase above it”; evidence: “measured as the height of the water above the normal predicted astronomical tide.” The baseline and relative measure are preserved; no scale or denominator is changed.
